description: Drag-and-drop file upload area built on react-dropzone. Supports file and image modes, multiple file selection, file preview with removal, and a customizable drop message. Manages internal file state and exposes onChange for controlled usage.
useCases: File attachment upload in survey questions (file-upload question type)
Image upload for survey branding, logos, and background customization
Bulk import of respondent lists or CSV data files
Media attachment inputs in form builders
